Mod-p logic sound: P=251 prime >136 so all falling factorials nonzero mod P; nonzero mod-P minor => nonzero integer minor => rank_Q >= rank_Fp, so F_251 full column rank 9453 => ker_Q=0 => h0=0 at specialization. Auditor independently recompiled both C kernels with gcc+OpenMP and reran full 9460x9453 eliminations: both returned PIVOTS=9453 FULL COLUMN RANK, matching archived logs. Parallel elimination has no rank-affecting race (pivot-row read-only during below-elimination). Semicontinuity transfer is standard: h0 upper-semicontinuous over flat family of fat points over distinct-point configuration space (irreducible); vanishing at one closed Q-point implies vanishing at general/C-general point. (-1)-lemma conclusion correct (D.C=136e-43S, adjunction S=3e-1 gives D.C=7e+43>0), with trivial presentation slip that minimum is 43 (Ei, e=0) not 50 (e>=1); this does not affect emptiness proof which does not rely on it. Standard specialization-rank method does not defeat novelty of the exact cell decision.
